events.summary: Urza met Lyna on Rath and they agreed to help each other escape.
events.quote: Lyna wanted Urza's help to escape from Rath.

events.summary: Lyna approached Ertai at the Erratic Portal and promised to help open it in exchange for letting the Soltari flee.
events.quote: Lyna approached Ertai when he studied the runes of the Erratic Portal

events.summary: The Weatherlight and the Soltari escaped, but Urza deactivated the portal stranding Ertai, who was captured by Greven il-Vec.
events.quote: Ertai was stranded on the wrong side and got captured by Greven il-Vec .

relations.quote: Lyna was the emissary of the Soltari
the two agreed to help one another
